boundary: Manufacturer-controlled exact-grade source candidate only. Promotion to material-grade-v2 requires exact source revision/date, immutable fingerprint and field-level semantic/test-context review.

entries.manufacturerDescription: Low-density polyethylene resin for conventional injection moulding, including housewares, toys, containers and compounding.
manufacturerProcessingContext: manufacturer page publishes melt/mould-temperature and injection-pressure guidance; retain as supplier guidance only, never a universal production recipe
entries.value: Provides exact-grade manufacturer context for the raw OpenMMS fault-monitoring experiment, so its measured pressure/force/temperature traces can be tied to a named resin rather than generic LDPE.
entries.limitations: Typical manufacturer properties and process guidance require exact revision/test conditions and do not establish site-specific validated limits.
